diagnosticSummary.nextDiagnostic: Use the existing opt-in bounded store for start/end spans around assembly preparation, ranking, selection, sequencing, output validation and deferred cleanup, with one elapsed-time origin; reproduce a specific failure before changing recommendation behavior.
